title: 14.7. Sappaccayadukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Sappaccayaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naappaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Sappaccayo dhammo naappaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
Appaccayo dhammo naappaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekaṁ, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā dve …pe… upanissaye dve …pe… avigate ekaṁ. (Saṅkhataṁ sappaccayasadisaṁ.)
